method: bench box K (ltsp-k, gfx1151, balanced 85 W, quiet cooling, weak die contact), pod-kbench k_run, one lease for the whole stage, ROCm 7.2.4 runtime libs (the binary is built with therock 10.1 clang on control-node); each case's process starts at Tctl <= 50 C (<= 90 s wait) and K's loadavg <= 6; the bench alternates ref/new rounds inside one process, so no ABBA process order is added
